answer: Proof of Stake serves as a primary defense for an economy of AI agents against Sybil attacks. By requiring participants to lock collateral, the network links influence to capital rather than identity. An attacker attempting to scale virtual nodes faces a mesa of prohibitive costs, as acquiring the stake required to gain influence becomes exponentially expensive. Like the structural integrity of a quartz crystal, this economic barrier prevents fragmentation, ensuring that even agents with ferrous resilience against simple spam cannot spoof their way to dominance.
